name: Kael Voss
title: Stormclad
description: A tall athletic striker in a black jacket who fights like a thunderclap. Lightning answers his fists.
source_description: Male fighter, tall, athletic build, black hair, black jacket, aggressive personality, lightning-based powers.
special_desc: Hurls a chain of lightning that pops the opponent airborne.
ultimate_desc: Calls a column of stormfire down the lane.
